Prashant Kishor Accuses BJP of Using Women's Group in Bihar Polls

Political strategist Prashant Kishor has accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of using members of the 'Jivika Didis' women's self-help group to intimidate voters during the Bankipur by-election campaign in Bihar. Kishor stated that if the women were not removed, he would stage a protest. The election campaign is in its final stages, with candidates intensifying their efforts to secure victory.
